failure.title: Client query-policy coverage loaded React Native Flow syntax in the general harness
failure.note: The retained query test and both harness configurations show a pre-collection Rollup parse failure at React Native's Flow-only import typeof declaration.
failure.diagnosis: The source-adjacent general Vitest suite resolved React Native's package entry before its test-local mock applied. That harness does not own the established React Native transform boundary, while the native harness already provides a stable alias and collects the same production source for coverage.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
